title: Payment-triggered delivery loops — one per Universal Prompt family
subtitle: EVT-006 Payment Confirmed → n8n → LOOP-PAY-{family}; full prompt text in the booklet §3

loops.task: Resolve scope from the order; run intake; research and analyse the client problem; draft the deliverable to the tier extent; evaluate; render charts and briefing video; route to human release.
Confirm the Zoho edition and scopes; configure modules, fields, workflows and roles in a sandbox; run test scripts; capture configuration evidence; prepare training; route to release.
Assemble the licensed product version; tailor it to the client profile for Standard/Premium; generate the walkthrough video; stamp licence and version; route to release.

loops.family: Online Shop reports and instant products
loops.task: Bind the instant product to the buyer; generate the personalised layer (name, sector, country); run tier conformance; deliver to the portal.
As UP-02, with extended integration and data-migration checks.
Validate inputs; run the deterministic formula; explain the result; render the result chart; deliver; offer the next Sprint.
Run the diagnostic question set; score deterministically against the rubric; benchmark against peers; draft findings and action plan; render scorecard and briefing video; route to release.
Open the subscription cycle; refresh data; produce the cycle deliverable and usage statement; schedule the next cycle; monitor alerts.
Open the retainer month; track allowance; produce the scheduled outputs and progress report; prepare the review pack; human lead presents.
Confirm scope and licences; design the solution blueprint; configure and integrate; test (UAT); train; go live with hypercare; capture evidence at each gate.

Confirm stage and gate; collect project evidence; run demand, technical and financial analysis; build or update the model; draft the stage deliverable; evaluate; senior human release; update gate status.
Run conflict check; assemble the evidence pack; route to the registered partner with scope and deadline; track partner SLA; QA the partner report; release with partner sign-off.

Verify consent and lawful purpose; run identity, registry, screening and evidence checks via approved vendors; synthesise findings; human and partner review of hits; release the report with evidence manifest.
Resolve country, sector and entitlement; pull AIIM registers with fact IDs and grades; generate the brief or data pack; render Infogram maps and charts; release; start watch-list alerts.
Confirm mandate and deal stage; provision or update the room; run the stage workflow (diligence, QoE, valuation, negotiation, legal, close); produce stage outputs; human release by the deal lead.
Assemble the resource or course; personalise; render video and charts; deliver; schedule follow-up.
Run under the parent service's transaction blueprint; write evidence events; raise exceptions to the parent workflow.
